title: Duerger Antidote
summary: Drink or throw to remove Poisoned-group conditions. Can cure Thulla during Cure the Poisoned Gnome.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one dose to remove Poisoned-group conditions.
fields.Throw: Action. Consume one dose to remove Poisoned-group conditions in a 3 ft radius. Item source lists a 10-turn duration.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Gekh Coal or Skickpit. Cannot be purchased or made with Alchemy.
fields.Base value: 40 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
